focus_areas: Species identification via coloration pattern (Yellow Head vs Black Head)
Structural integrity of the caudal fin despite blur
Edge definition and texture realism at the color boundary
custom_prompts_for_reflector: The primary failure mode here is likely a species hallucination or color inversion. The image shows a Yellow Head/Black Body pattern, while Rock Beauty is Black Head/Yellow Body. Focus heavily on whether the 'blur' on the tail is hiding a malformed structure or if the tail is simply out of focus. Use the animal_pose_auditor to check if the fins attach correctly to the body, as AI fish often have floating or fused fins.
image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a fish that appears to be an Angelfish or Butterflyfish. The fish exhibits a color pattern with a bright yellow anterior body (head and front) and a black posterior body (back and tail area). This is the inverse of the target class 'Rock Beauty' (Holocanthus tricolor), which typically has a black head and yellow tail. The background is a blurred blue aquatic environment.
